searchText: Large price swings have historically lead to surprises in the ice age timing. Someone should recalculate when the ice age is given the recent price swing. <@!301186049323958275> yeah I was talking with the author of this script (https://github.com/TrueBlocks/tokenomics/tree/main/explorations/difficulty) who confirmed the July ETA this week Historically, any update has always been delayed. Given the current pressure on the network, letting the ice age kick in will have really, really big impact on the network. I suggest implementing an EIP in Berlin that kicks it forward at least to the fall. Gives you enough time to do another hardfork without rushing. i feel like someone here can point me to a tool that lets me compute the distribution of opcodes across a span of blocks e.g. "how many times does the `DIFFICULTY` opcode appear in all executions from block N....M"
